query: SELECT s.id, s.activityId, s.studentId, s.status, s.submittedAt, a.title as activityTitle, a.userId as professorId FROM activity_submissions s JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activityId ORDER BY s.submittedAt DESC LIMIT 10;
